boundary: Manually composed schematic; literature and taxonomy tables are available. No numerical regeneration is claimed.

title: Benchmarking framework
boundary: Workflow schematic and design tables; no method-performance values.

title: Evaluation on simulated and conventional datasets
boundary: 740 pairs in the main figure and 698 in Extended Data. Per-dataset maxima are a post hoc envelope.

title: ReDeeM
boundary: 21 configurations with saved GDC/CBDir. Historical scatter and stream plots are retained; original coordinate provenance is incomplete.

title: Spatial evaluation, runtime and read-depth sensitivity
boundary: ST_small contains 608 spots. The TopicVelo source value was corrected to 0.4838869706599916, matching the final figure.

title: Frozen composite scores and tool capabilities
boundary: 19 configurations; 0.6 accuracy rank + 0.4 scalability rank, excluding stability. Eight differences remain relative to later values across four domains.

title: Age-related examples and future directions
boundary: The exact 784-gene list and matching run have not been recovered; this does not establish validated age-related dynamics.

title: Method taxonomy and dyngen simulation design
boundary: 14 topologies and 42 seeded datasets; the former ED2 has been incorporated.

title: cellDancer simulation design
boundary: Three scenarios and 30 datasets; continuous U/S values are not observed integer counts.

title: Overview of real-world datasets
boundary: 10 conventional datasets and metadata for 176 HuBMAP datasets; example embeddings are historical artwork.

title: Cosine comparisons on simulated data
boundary: Boxplot sample sizes, medians and quartiles were checked against unit-level values; missing values are not replaced with zeros.

title: High- and low-dimensional comparisons
boundary: 698 paired dataset-by-method values; means and sample SDs were recomputed by topology.

title: GDC on real-world datasets
boundary: Aligned with the main-figure source values; 18 HuBMAP configurations, with no valid TopicVelo value for this task.

title: scNT metabolic-labeling reference
boundary: 1,947 reference cells and 19 configurations; projected cosines were recomputed per cell. Preprocessing differs across pipelines.

title: scLT lineage reference
boundary: 1,756 reference cells and 19 configurations; original membership and random-selection records for the five clone examples are incomplete.

title: ST_raw spatial evaluation
boundary: 1,292 spots and five relationships; distinct from ST_small in main Fig. 5a.

title: Paired consistency across contexts
boundary: 19 x 608 = 11,552 paired spatial results; 18 methods have gene-space scores, while VeloAE remains NA.

title: KPTracer
boundary: 754 cells, four corrected-eval1 relationships and a denominator of 706; completed TFvelo and TopicVelo outputs were checked.

title: Metascape and historical age-related examples
boundary: Nine configurations with 519/809 mapped genes in top100/top200 lists, respectively. Enrichment reports were imported; age-example provenance gaps remain explicit.
